configurePresets.name: debug
configurePresets.description: What you want 99% of the time: assertions on, fast builds, full warnings.

configurePresets.name: release
configurePresets.description: Optimised build. Use it when an exercise asks you to reason about what the optimiser does.

configurePresets.name: solutions
configurePresets.description: Also builds and tests the reference solutions under solutions/.

configurePresets.name: asan
configurePresets.description: Catches buffer overruns, use-after-free and undefined behaviour at runtime. Several exercises say to re-run under this.

configurePresets.name: tsan
configurePresets.description: Catches data races. Use it for chapter 12 (interrupts and atomics).

configurePresets.name: target
configurePresets.description: Cross-compiles chapters 15-17 for the board with arm-none-eabi-gcc. Run them with ./mec flash <id>.

configurePresets.name: target-solutions
configurePresets.description: As `target`, and also cross-compiles the chapter 15-17 reference solutions.
